data.name: Nexus Wars
data.detailed_description:
Roadmap


About the Game

Early Access Nexus Wars: A Sci-Fi Odyssey in the Making

STAGE 1: Dive into a Relentless Text-Based Adventure

Step into Nexus Wars, a gripping survival saga set 4,970 years in a parallel future, syncing with real-world time. You’re a Frame—a synthetic, clone, or bio-engineered shell—your consciousness ensnared in a 24-hour mind-swap loop by an unknown force via the HyperNet, an intergalactic network of instant hyperspace access. Each loop thrusts you into dire peril, demanding quick wits to survive a galaxy of danger, discovery, and enigma.

Key Features:

  • Text-Based Zero Release (Version 0.0.5): A rich, choice-driven narrative where every decision shapes your fate in a brutal universe.

  • Infinite Loops, Endless Stakes: Face 24-hour cycles, resetting into new Frames on death or disconnection, as you hunt the HyperNet’s dark secret.

  • Nine Playable Factions: Command The Guild (Anu'Aki), Cho'Zen Empire, Terran Federation, Executive Order, Reapers Swarm, Saradook (Crimson Sun), Trinity Union (Synthetics), Vodah Collective, or Ultra Consortium—each with distinct lore, combat flair, and struggles.

  • Hostile Galaxy, Ruthless GAME MASTER: Battle a cunning AI bent on your demise, weaving morally fraught choices that test survival and yield Sols (intergalactic currency).

  • Epic Sci-Fi Realm: Roam a 5,000-year-advanced galaxy blending Cyberpunk’s neon grit, Star Wars’s vastness, and Firefly’s edge, with ancient Sun Harvesters and lurking horrors.

Unravel the Mystery, Risk It All: Every choice teeters between survival, riches, and truth. Will you shatter the eternal trap or fall to cosmic chaos?

STAGE 2: Mech Wars Rise

Command mech armies in an auto-battler showdown. Lead 9 factions with 240+ units, plus numerous NPC factions boasting 200+ units each, all armed with diverse skills. Master strategic PvP and shape dynamic, player-forged stories.

STAGE 3: Space Combat Unleashed

Take the helm in strategic space battles and solar system conquests. Customize ships, dominate action-packed combat, and carve your path through an evolving frontier.

STAGE 4: A Universe Expands

Immerse yourself in faction lobbies, deep character creation, and customization. RPG and FPS elements weave into the fabric, amplifying engagement and depth.

STAGE 5: Calamity of Eternal Wars

Descend into madness as dark, alien forces threaten all. Unite factions in a Souls-like struggle within impossible realms, facing the beyond in a haunting, collaborative climax.

A Living Universe Awaits
Nexus Wars evolves with strategy, RPG/FPS, and space combat, all set in a retro-inspired saga of warfare and mystery. Join our live service journey, fueled by community passion!

data.short_description: Dive into Nexus Wars, a relentless sci-fi odyssey 4,970 years in the future. Trapped in a 24-hour mind-swap loop as a Frame, survive dire danger, explore a hostile galaxy, and unravel the HyperNet’s mystery. Nine factions, epic lore, and a brutal GAME MASTER await. Will you break free or fall?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 and above (64 bits)
  • Processor: Intel, AMD 2 cores CPU at 2Ghz
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon™ HD 7730, NVIDIA GeForce® GT 640
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: System Requirements are estimate
